academy.enemyGallerySubtitle: Habits and traps that catch even experienced operators

enemyDescriptions.pagerPhantom: Traps operators inside scrolling text. Once inside, few remember to press q.
enemyDescriptions.vimTrapMonk: A silent guardian that locks you between modes. Many fall while trying to exit.
enemyDescriptions.resetDemon: Feeds on lost commits and force pushes, turning Git history into a wasteland.
enemyDescriptions.mergeConflictHydra: Resolve one conflict and two more appear in its place.
enemyDescriptions.backgroundJobGhost: A silent process consuming resources in the dark. You never see it coming.
enemyDescriptions.captainCat: Scatters randomly named files across the filesystem in chaotic feline form.
enemyDescriptions.symlinkWraith: Creates phantom links that lead to nowhere—or to disaster.
enemyDescriptions.diskHydra: Nine heads devour disk space. Remove one and two grow back.
enemyDescriptions.portMimic: Hides on random nonstandard ports, moving and dodging until connections time out.
